name: Kisuki (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kisuki town emblem in red: a ring beneath a smaller ring with a pointed top, like a stylised character.
history: Flag of the former town of Kisuki in Shimane Prefecture, dissolved on 2004-11-01. The municipal emblem was adopted on 15 October 1958.

features.role: Kisuki town emblem — a ring beneath a smaller ring with a pointed top, like a stylised character
